content:
Mina Patel: FYI — HC Bank reported a P1 for checkout requests on their dedicated pool, seeing p95/p99 spike ~30% starting ~09:12 UTC. Support ticket #5872.
Devon Li: ack. Can someone paste the customer config? Which model + pool?
Mina Patel: model: redwood-llama-13b-q4, pool: dedicated-us-west-2-pool-7. Traffic spike aligns with batch job at 09:10.
Sasha Gomez: digging into logs now. Seeing queue backlog + increased decode time. Link to recent traces: https://redwood.internal/traces/5872 :eyes:
Leo Carter: shallow mitigation options: 1) route HC Bank to fallback model (redwood-llama-7b) 2) increase pool instances 3) enable short TTL caching for repeated prefixes.
Priya Rao: can we do fallback routing quickly? That needs a canary rule and support sign-off. I can do it if infra approves.
Devon Li: I can approve autoscale bump for 30m. Sasha, do you think decode latency is model-size related or kv-cache pressure?
Sasha Gomez: looks like kv-cache growth — warm cache on earlier requests then huge cold starts from scheduled job. Increasing instances helps short-term. Fallback to 7b will reduce latency but might affect QA/outputs.
Mina Patel: Customer demands <200ms p99. Current is ~420ms. They asked for ETA on workaround.
Priya Rao: I'll prep fallback canary. Steps:
- add route rule for HC Bank to redwood-llama-7b canary
- enable 5% traffic shift for 10m
- monitor p99 and errors
Devon Li: +1. Deploy window requested now. Sasha/Leo, can you do autoscale bump at the same time (10:15 UTC)?
Leo Carter: I can trigger autoscale increase to +3 instances at 10:14 and revert at 10:50. Command:
`./infra scale pool dedicated-us-west-2-pool-7 --add 3 --until 10:50`
OpsBot: deploy scheduled by Priya Rao at 10:15 UTC — fallback rule applied to HC Bank (canary 5%).
Sasha Gomez: monitoring — after canary p99 dropped to 190ms for canary traffic. Errors stable.
Mina Patel: ok, tell HC Bank: temporary routing to smaller model + autoscale. Ask them to confirm app QA. I'll draft message for support.
Priya Rao: rolling the canary to 100% over 10m if metrics hold. Will ping when done.
Devon Li: once stable, open follow-up to evaluate long-term options: customer-tailored kv-cache settings or reserved burst for scheduled jobs.
Mina Patel: owners: Priya (rollback/canary), Leo (autoscale), Sasha (metrics & root cause), Devon (customer comms). I'll update ticket #5872.
Priya Rao: noted. Ping me for code review if you need rule approvals: PR #12244.
Devon Li: PR review pinged. @Sasha can you eyeball the traffic filters?
Sasha Gomez: on it, will review in 10.
Mina Patel: thanks everyone. Will update after final handoff. :thumbsup:
